messages:
maria-partnerships: Quick sync — NimbusEdge (HW SI) wants to go live in Azure Gov + GCP marketplace. Partner asked for SOC2 summary, pen-test report (recent), and firmware attestation. Target launch ~6 weeks. Who owns collecting artifacts and redaction?

sam-security: I can take SOC2 + pen-test ingestion. Need to confirm pen scope (external vs internal) and whether 3rd-party witness required. Can someone confirm PCI/HSM involvement? @jon-eng? :mag:

jon-eng: They use an on-box HSM for signing firmware blobs. We'll need HSM attestation docs + firmware hash chain. Also check that pen scope includes firmware image extraction + bootloader.

maria-partnerships: Good to know. Partner asked for a single zip with redacted PII. They asked if we can escrow artifacts for marketplace reviewers. Is presign approach ok?

lee-ops: Presigned S3 is fine. We have a short-lived presign bucket for partner uploads: s3://marketplace-uploads/presign-2024. Retention policy is 30 days by default but we can extend to 90 for review. I'll create presign keys and post example.

ci-bot: Checklist created: [ChecklistID: MKP-4291] 
- SOC2 summary (owner: sam-security)
- Pen-test report + scope (owner: sam-security)
- Firmware attestation (owner: jon-eng)
- Artifact redaction record (owner: tara-sis)
- Presign upload link (owner: lee-ops)

sam-security: Thanks @lee-ops. For pen-test, ask partner to provide: scope document, CVSS export for high findings, and evidence of remediation or risk acceptance. If tests are older than 12 months we require re-test or compensating controls.

tara-sis: I'll take redaction. Quick q: do we need auditor statement for redaction chain-of-custody, or is a signed attestation from partner sufficient?

sam-security: Prefer auditor attestation for SOC/pen pack where possible, but signed partner attestation is acceptable for firmware screenshots + manifest if auditor docs aren't available. We'll flag as "limited assurance" in the intake notes.

lee-ops: Presign example (paste into partner reply):
```
aws s3 presign s3://marketplace-uploads/presign-2024/nimbusedge-artifacts.zip --expires-in 604800
```
Please include checksum: sha256:nimbus-edge-<hex> and a small manifest.json with file list.

maria-partnerships: Great. Let's split owners and deadlines: SAM - ingest SOC/pen by EOD Friday (1712730000), JON - firmware attestation + hashes by next Tue, LEE - presign link by EOD today, TARA - initial redaction guide by Mon. I'll ping partner with upload instructions and the checklist.

sam-security: Adding action: will validate pen scope on receipt and confirm whether 3rd-party witness is required. If witness needed, partner must provide available dates in next 2 weeks.

jon-eng: If they need HSM attestation, ask for HSM vendor attestation + serial numbers and signing key fingerprint. We'll schedule a quick runbook to verify firmware hash chain.

maria-partnerships: I'll draft the partner email now. Quick draft: @nimbusedge Hey — attaching presign link + manifest template. Please upload SOC2 summary, pen-test bundle, firmware attestation, and manifest. Tell us if you need a witness window. Thanks — Maria.

tara-sis: small note: redaction template -> please remove PII, full usernames, and ephemeral tokens; replace with <REDACTED_REASON>. I'll post template in a follow-up thread. :white_check_mark:

lee-ops: Presign link posted in DM and ACLs configured. Expiry 7 days, can reissue.

maria-partnerships: Awesome team — will update partner and follow up on actions. If anything blocks the pen evidence ingestion, set priority to P0 in this channel. :pray:
